scope: Cell lysis and protein extraction were performed as previously described. Briefly, following treatment, cells were washed with PBS and lysed in lysis buffer [4% SDS, 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (TEABC), 10 mM sodium fluoride, 1 mM sodium orthovanadate, 1 mM β-glycerophosphate and 2.5 mM sodium pyrophosphate] via sonication at 4°C for 4 min at 10 sec/pulse and a frequency of 0.05 Hz.
Following centrifugation at 16,000 × g at 20°C for 15 min, the supernatant was collected and protein concentration was determined using a Pierce™ Bicinchoninic acid assay (Thermo Scientific, Inc.).
